svg.title: Gamma PDF: your research, connected
svg.desc: Save papers and web clips with Gamma Connector. Import and export Obsidian vaults and Zotero libraries, import Notion exports, and let Codex search and read your Gamma library with read-only access.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Bring your notes. Take your highlights with you.
Save the next paper straight from your browser.
One click. Paper, metadata, folder, labels.
